en-US.title: FitCheck Coach
en-US.subtitle: Fitness logging for goals
en-US.description:
FitCheck Coach brings your weight, nutrition, steps, and workout logs together around your goal: cutting, maintaining, or bulking.

LOG AT YOUR OWN PACE
Record your morning weight, then add calories, protein, steps, and training later. Log only what you know. Blank fields stay missing instead of being counted as zero in averages. Edit past entries whenever you need to.

UNDERSTAND YOUR PROGRESS
See weight trends, calorie and step charts, recent averages, and goal projections. Rule-based coaching summaries help you review your routine in the context of your chosen goal.

KEEP YOUR TRAINING HISTORY CLOSE
Record exercises, sets, reps, and weights. Reuse workout and exercise names you have logged before, review past performance, and track bodyweight exercises by reps. Form-focused sessions are part of your training context.

YOUR LOGS, ON YOUR DEVICE
Fitness logs and your local profile stay on your device. Export and restore local backups from Settings. There is no cloud account or automatic cross-device sync in this version.

FitCheck Coach is a fitness logging tool, not a medical device. Calorie targets and goal projections are estimates, not guarantees.
en-US.promoText: Track weight, nutrition, steps, and workouts around your current fitness goal.
